product_overview: ChineseEVs is a research feed and detail-view experience for exploring mock-post content and related responses. Users can inspect a focus post, cross-highlight linked regions from related cards, and filter or group the related panel through span interactions.
core_goals: Browse the ChineseEVs research feed and open a post detail view
Inspect cross-highlighted regions between the focus post and related cards
Filter the related panel by clicking highlighted spans in the focus post
Group related cards by topic by clicking highlighted spans inside related cards
Reveal below-fold highlighted content by hovering related cards

features.name: Research feed and focus-post detail viewing
features.description: Users can browse the ChineseEVs feed and open a post detail view that shows the focus post alongside the related-stacks panel.
user_flows: Navigate to /ChineseEVs -> Review the research feed -> Open a post detail view -> See the focus post and related responses panel
Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> View the selected post detail layout -> Inspect the focus post content -> Inspect the related-stacks aside panel

features.name: Related-card to focus-post cross-highlight
features.description: Users can hover related cards to highlight linked regions in the focus post with two levels of emphasis and a non-reflowing faux-bold treatment.
user_flows: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Hover a related card -> See all linked focus regions highlighted with a faint category color
Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Hover a specific span within a related card -> See that one focus region highlighted more strongly with a light pastel shade
Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Hover a specific span within a related card -> Observe the emphasized sub-span render with text-shadow while font-weight stays unchanged
Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Hover a related card with overlapping linked regions -> Observe the highlighted areas keep a uniform shade without dark compounding

features.name: Focus-span filtering of related responses
features.description: Users can click a highlighted span in the focus post to filter the related panel to matching posts and toggle the filter off by clicking again.
user_flows: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Click a highlighted span in the focus post -> See the related panel narrow to linked posts and the span remain dark and stable
Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Click the same highlighted span again -> See the related panel return to its previous unfiltered state

features.name: Below-fold highlight auto-reveal
features.description: When a highlighted focus-post region is below the collapsed fold, hovering the related card automatically expands the post to reveal the region and then collapses it again when the highlight ends.
user_flows: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Hover a related card whose linked region is below the fold -> See the focus post expand to reveal the highlight and show Read less
Move the cursor away -> See the focus post collapse back to Read more
Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Manually expand the post -> Hover a related card below the fold -> See the highlight reveal without forcing the manual expansion to collapse

features.name: Related-card topic grouping and navigation guards
features.description: Users can click on interactive areas within related cards to group the panel by topic without navigating away, while clicking the card itself opens the linked detail view.
user_flows: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Click a highlighted span on a related card -> See the related panel group by that topic and show the Grouped by pill
Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Click the same highlighted span on a related card again -> See the grouping clear and the panel return to its prior arrangement
Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Click the top strip of a related card -> Open the linked post detail view
Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Click a relation category tag on a related card -> See the panel group by topic while the URL stays unchanged
Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Click a related-card interaction control -> See the control toggle in place while the URL stays unchanged

features.name: Reply composer avatar fallback
features.description: The reply composer displays the current user's avatar in the post detail view and falls back to a placeholder when no custom avatar is set.
user_flows: Navigate to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id] -> Open a post detail view -> Observe the reply composer avatar render with a fallback placeholder when no avatar is set

routes.description: Research feed rendered entirely from local mock JSON (no backend, no login). Shows a hashtag header with stats, a list of post cards, and a "Related responses" aside panel.
Focus-post detail view with the highlight layer, a reply composer, and the related-stacks aside panel.

features.name: Focus-post cross-highlight from related cards
features.description: Hovering a related card in the aside lights up the linked regions of the focus post. Level 1 (card hovered) paints every linked region a faint category colour; Level 2 (a specific card span hovered) paints that one region a stronger but still light shade and emphasises an optional bold sub-span. The emphasis is non-reflowing faux-bold (text-shadow), never a real font-weight (stays 400), so the article never reflows. Overlapping marks never compound into darker bands.
user_interactions: Hover a related card in the aside to faintly highlight its linked focus regions (L1)
Hover a specific span within a related card to strongly highlight that one region (L2)
Observe the emphasised sub-span (span[data-fc]) thicken via text-shadow with font-weight staying 400 and no reflow

features.name: Click-to-filter a focus span
features.description: Clicking a highlighted span in the focus post filters the related panel to the posts linked to that span. The clicked span stays visibly dark and stable (computed backgroundColor rgb(193,199,209)) until it is toggled off by clicking it again.
user_interactions: Click a highlighted span (mark[data-fs] inside [data-testid=focus-reveal]) in the focus post
Observe the span stays dark and stable after 700ms
Click the same span again to clear the filter

features.name: Related-card span click groups the panel (topic anchor)
features.description: Clicking a highlighted span on a related card toggles a topic anchor: the panel groups around that card's topic, showing the "Grouped by:" pill and grouped layout. Clicking the same span again clears the grouping. This is a DIFFERENT mechanism from the focus-post span click (which applies the overlap filter) — the two must not be conflated.
user_interactions: Click a highlighted span on a related card to group the panel by its topic
See the "Grouped by:" pill and grouped layout appear
Click the same span again to clear the grouping

features.name: Auto-reveal of a highlight below the Read-more fold
features.description: When a highlighted region sits below the collapsed "Read more" fold, the focus post auto-expands (driving the Read-more state) to reveal it, then collapses back to the clamped state when the highlight ends. A manual Read-more expansion is never auto-collapsed.
user_interactions: Hover a related card whose linked region is below the fold
Observe the focus post expand to reveal the highlighted region (Read less)
Move the cursor away and observe the post collapse back (Read more)

features.name: Related-card navigation and in-card interaction guards
features.description: The related card's root Paper is the navigation target, so clicking anywhere on the card — including the top strip to the right of the relation tags — opens the linked post's detail view (router.push to /ChineseEVs/posts/[id]). In-card controls call stopPropagation so they act in place without navigating: a relation category tag groups the panel by topic ("Grouped by:") and an interaction control (reply/like/bookmark/ share) toggles that action, both with the URL unchanged.
user_interactions: Click the top-right strip of a related card in the aside and observe navigation to that post
Click a relation category tag and observe the panel group ("Grouped by:") with the URL unchanged
Click a related card's interaction control (e.g. Favourites) and observe the URL stay unchanged

features.name: Reply composer avatar fallback
features.description: The reply composer on the detail view renders the current user's avatar, falling back to Mantine's placeholder when none is set. It no longer uses the literal string 'defaultAvatarUrl', which previously resolved to /ChineseEVs/posts/defaultAvatarUrl and produced spurious route requests.
user_interactions: Observe the reply composer avatar render without any request to a "defaultAvatarUrl" path

known_limitations.issue: Related cards are visually stacked and their hover handlers are debounced (~200-300ms)
known_limitations.impact: Automated hover must target the correct card and allow settle time before asserting cross-highlight effects

known_limitations.issue: The ChineseEVs feed and detail views are backed entirely by local mock JSON
known_limitations.impact: No live backend or authentication is exercised on these routes
